say:1:1021523001:0.text: Phew, finally got rid of the trouble!
say:1:1021523001:0.male: Phew, finally got rid of the trouble!
say:1:1021523001:0.female: Phew, finally got rid of the trouble!

say:3:1021523002:0.text: That was fast! I just finished drawing one glimmerbloom!
say:3:1021523002:0.source_cn: 哦不——这也太快了！我才刚画完一只荧荧花！
say:3:1021523002:0.male: That was fast! I just finished drawing one glimmerbloom!
say:3:1021523002:0.female: That was fast! I just finished drawing one glimmerbloom!

say:5:1021523003:0.text: You were drawing when we were in combat?
say:5:1021523003:0.source_cn: 我们在战斗的时候，你已经在画画了？
say:5:1021523003:0.male: You were drawing when we were in combat?
say:5:1021523003:0.female: You were drawing when we were in combat?

say:6:1021523004:0.text: The idea of us losing never crossed your mind, huh?
say:6:1021523004:0.source_cn: ……你还真是一点都不担心我们会输啊。
say:6:1021523004:0.male: The idea of us losing never crossed your mind, huh?
say:6:1021523004:0.female: The idea of us losing never crossed your mind, huh?

say:7:1021523005:0.text: You bet! You guys are the most reliable partners I've ever had! There's nothing you can't solve.
say:7:1021523005:0.source_cn: 当然。你们是我有史以来遇到的最可靠的搭档！没有你们解决...
say:7:1021523005:0.male: You bet! You guys are the most reliable partners I've ever had! There's nothing you can't solve.
say:7:1021523005:0.female: You bet! You guys are the most reliable partners I've ever had! There's nothing you can't solve.

say:8:1021523006:0.text: There's another important reason—I needed to draw or I'd start forgetting some details!
say:8:1021523006:0.source_cn: 除此之外，还有一个重要原因——如果再不画下来，我就要开...
say:8:1021523006:0.male: There's another important reason—I needed to draw or I'd start forgetting some details!
say:8:1021523006:0.female: There's another important reason—I needed to draw or I'd start forgetting some details!

choice_prompt:9:1021523006.text: There's another important reason—I needed to draw or I'd start forgetting some details!
choice_prompt:9:1021523006.source_cn: 除此之外，还有一个重要原因——如果再不画下来，我就要开始忘记一些细节了！
choice_prompt:9:1021523006.male: There's another important reason—I needed to draw or I'd start forgetting some details!
choice_prompt:9:1021523006.female: There's another important reason—I needed to draw or I'd start forgetting some details!

say:10:1021523007:0.text: Oh? I thought a powerful mage like you never forget stuff.
say:10:1021523007:0.source_cn: 哇哦，我还以为像你这么厉害的魔法师不会忘东忘西呢。
say:10:1021523007:0.male: Oh? I thought a powerful mage like you never forget stuff.
say:10:1021523007:0.female: Oh? I thought a powerful mage like you never forget stuff.

say:11:1021523008:0.text: I need some time to finish these drawings.
say:11:1021523008:0.source_cn: 我还需要一点时间，得赶紧把它们样子都画下来才行。
say:11:1021523008:0.male: I need some time to finish these drawings.
say:11:1021523008:0.female: I need some time to finish these drawings.

say:12:1021523010:0.text: I'm afraid I must ask you to wait here...
say:12:1021523010:0.source_cn: 恐怕要麻烦你们，在这里等——
say:12:1021523010:0.male: I'm afraid I must ask you to wait here...
say:12:1021523010:0.female: I'm afraid I must ask you to wait here...

say:19:1021523012:0.text: Hey, Ari! What's wrong this time?
say:19:1021523012:0.male: Hey, Ari! What's wrong this time?
say:19:1021523012:0.female: Hey, Ari! What's wrong this time?

say:24:1021523014:0.text: Is Ari hungry? After all, we've been traveling for so long without a break.
say:24:1021523014:0.source_cn: Ari是不是饿了？毕竟我们都走了这么久了，还没有休息过呢。
say:24:1021523014:0.male: Is Ari hungry? After all, we've been traveling for so long without a break.
say:24:1021523014:0.female: Is Ari hungry? After all, we've been traveling for so long without a break.

say:25:1021523015:0.text: Chippy... You are the one who's hungry, right?
say:25:1021523015:0.source_cn: 满满……肚子饿的其实是你吧？
say:25:1021523015:0.male: Chippy... You are the one who's hungry, right?
say:25:1021523015:0.female: Chippy... You are the one who's hungry, right?

say:29:1021523017:0.text: Chippy's got a point. Ari's always loved food since little.
say:29:1021523017:0.source_cn: 其实满满说的有道理。Ari从小到大都很贪吃。
say:29:1021523017:0.male: Chippy's got a point. Ari's always loved food since little.
say:29:1021523017:0.female: Chippy's got a point. Ari's always loved food since little.

say:30:1021523018:0.text: Anywhere we can stop for a break? It's time to let Ari and Tofu rest.
say:30:1021523018:0.source_cn: 有没有能落脚的地方？我想也是时候让他和Tofu休息一下了。
say:30:1021523018:0.male: Anywhere we can stop for a break? It's time to let Ari and Tofu rest.
say:30:1021523018:0.female: Anywhere we can stop for a break? It's time to let Ari and Tofu rest.

say:31:1021523019:0.text: Let's head to <style="highlight">Lunadorf</style> then! It's a haven of great food!
say:31:1021523019:0.male: Let's head to <style="highlight">Lunadorf</style> then! It's a haven of great food!
say:31:1021523019:0.female: Let's head to <style="highlight">Lunadorf</style> then! It's a haven of great food!

say:32:1021523020:0.text: You can learn more about the animals we've encountered today from the villagers, Jaiden.
say:32:1021523020:0.source_cn: Jaiden你也能趁这个机会和村里人打听一下今天记录的...
say:32:1021523020:0.male: You can learn more about the animals we've encountered today from the villagers, Jaiden.
say:32:1021523020:0.female: You can learn more about the animals we've encountered today from the villagers, Jaiden.

choice:9:0:1.text: You've got a point. I need to start making more notes too.
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 你说的对，我也得多记笔记
choice:9:0:1.male: You've got a point. I need to start making more notes too.
choice:9:0:1.female: You've got a point. I need to start making more notes too.

say:34:1021523009:0.text: Well, about the time of five battles. I have to finish drawing while I still remember.
say:34:1021523009:0.source_cn: 嗯，大概五场战斗的时间。我要趁着现在把它们的样子都画出来。
say:34:1021523009:0.male: Well, about the time of five battles. I have to finish drawing while I still remember.
say:34:1021523009:0.female: Well, about the time of five battles. I have to finish drawing while I still remember.

choice:9:1:2.text: How much longer do you need?
choice:9:1:2.male: How much longer do you need?
choice:9:1:2.female: How much longer do you need?
